plugins.name: pixelfx-godot
plugins.description: A skill for pixel art effects in Godot 4: use, recolor and bake the library's 244 effects (PixelFx2D, SpriteFrames), act them out, draft and refine new ones in GDScript, and port upstream pixelfx changes pixel for pixel.
